By means of this second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Jhinak Raj Alias Satyawrat, who is involved in Case Crime No. 185 of 2021, under Sections 376, 323 IPC, police station Sahjanwa, district Gorakhpur, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
The first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 06.02.2023 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 41530 of 2022.

Accordingly, the bail application of the applicant is rejected.
